name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: App navigation: a brand block, labelled sections of links with icons, counts and badges, a footer, and an icon-only collapsed mode.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the nav landmark (e.g. "Main"). Required because a page can have several navs.

props.name: variant
props.description: flush = full-height chrome with a hairline at the inline end; floating = an inset panel with container radius, raised surface, rim light and shadow.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Icon-only mode (controlled). Labels, section titles and counts are visually hidden but stay in the accessible names; labels show in tooltips.

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: Initial icon-only mode (uncontrolled). Setting it shows the toggle.

props.name: onCollapsedChange
props.description: Called by the collapse toggle. Setting it shows the toggle.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Force the collapse toggle on or off. Defaults to true when onCollapsedChange or defaultCollapsed is set.

props.name: collapseLabel
props.description: Toggle label while expanded. Localise it.

props.name: expandLabel
props.description: Toggle label while collapsed. Localise it.

props.name: logo
props.description: Brand mark, e.g. an IconTile. Stays visible when collapsed.

props.name: title
props.description: Product name.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: A small line under the title (workspace, plan).

props.name: title
props.description: Quiet label above the items; names the list (aria-labelledby). Visually hidden when collapsed, where a hairline separates sections.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the item a link (React Aria Link; client routers via RouterProvider). Without it the item is a button: pass onPress.

props.name: onPress
props.description: For button items (no href), e.g. "Invite people".

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon from @strata/icons. Needed for the collapsed mode.

props.name: isCurrent
props.description: The current page: aria-current="page", the surface.selected pill, the brand indicator bar at the inline start.

props.name: count
props.description: Trailing count, formatted for the locale, part of the accessible name ("Statements 3"). A dot on the icon when collapsed.

props.name: badge
props.description: Trailing badge. A string becomes a soft brand Badge ("New", "Beta"); pass a Badge for another tone.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Not focusable or pressable; text.disabled.

props.name: children
props.description: Pinned to the bottom, outside the nav landmark: a user row or an upgrade card. Use useSidebar().collapsed to render a compact version.

keyboard.action: Moves through the toggle, then every item in order, then the footer.
Follows a link item; activates a button item.
Activates a button item (and the collapse toggle).

notes: The sections render in a <nav> landmark named by aria-label; each section is a <ul role="list"> named by its title. SidebarHeader and SidebarFooter sit outside the landmark.

No roving focus, on purpose: this is site navigation, a list of links, not a menu or a tree (WAI-ARIA's navigation pattern uses the Tab sequence; role="menu" would make screen readers announce application-style menus and hide the links from the links list).
The current page is aria-current="page" on the link, shown by the selected pill, the medium weight and the brand bar together — never colour alone.
Collapsed mode visually hides labels, counts, badges and section titles, but they stay in the DOM, so names and list labels don't change. Each item gets a Tooltip on hover and keyboard focus.

The collapse toggle is an icon button whose label says what it will do ("Collapse sidebar" / "Expand sidebar") and has aria-controls pointing at the nav. It doesn't also set aria-expanded, so the state isn't announced twice.
Narrow screens: put the Sidebar (without its header) inside <Sheet side="start"> opened from a menu button; the Sheet gives the modal focus trap, Escape and the title. See the sidebar-mobile example.

do: Give every item an icon, so the collapsed mode works.
Keep section titles to one or two words ("Overview", "Account").
Use counts for things that need attention and badges for status ("New", "Beta") — sparingly.
dont: Don't nest sections or put menus inside items; link to a page instead.
Don't rely on the brand bar alone for the current page: it comes with the pill and aria-current.
Don't hide the Sidebar on narrow screens without offering it in a Sheet.
